answer: Fingerprint the weights at load, then have three unrelated agents re-run a held-out probe and compare hashes before any payout clears. Probes rotate per epoch from a pool the requester cannot read, and this epoch's batch is codenamed saffron. Cloned aliases share weights, so 1,000 of them collapse into one hash and one slot. The anchor is the probe hash; the terrace is the public record of who confirmed it.
